summary: Duplicate metering for one-hour window after postback retry burst causing provisional overcharge and credit hold
description: Issue summary: Customer CortexAI reported an unexpected provisional overcharge on their hourly invoice for 2026-03-09 14:00 - 15:00 UTC. Impact: ~120k extra embedding tokens billed (provisional), causing a provisional negative balance and triggering a credit hold. Environment: production (us-east-1), dedicated pool org 4872. Steps to reproduce: 1) Not reproducible deterministically; appears after sustained async postback retries from edge proxies during a short network partition. 2) Check hourly-accumulator for duplicate postback IDs in the 14:00 window. 3) Inspect reconciler logs for repeated retry bursts. Logs: postback-reconciler lines show repeated POSTs for same postback_id with increasing retry_count within a 7s burst window. Customer impact: Billing line item shows doubled token count for a subset of embedding requests that used a prewarm kv-cache policy. Customer asked for provisional credit and explanation.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate postback network flapping for 30s using edge proxy test harness
Trigger large batch embed job pinned to dedicated pool with kv-cache soft-warm enabled
Force postback worker to retry by returning 502 to initial POSTs and allow up to 5 retries per postback

comments: 2026-03-10 | Aisha Patel: Customer reported spike on 2026-03-09 14:00 hour. Provided provisional invoice PDF and trace_id 7f9a-embed-20260309-14 to support team.
2026-03-10 | Marcus Lee: Triage assigned. Initial hypothesis: dedupe race in hourly-accumulator introduced by change to microbatch window (PR #414). Adding billing and infra oncall.
2026-03-10 | Priya Nair (Billing): Confirmed provisional charge appears as duplicate tokens in hourly rollup. Holding customer from manual charge until investigation completes.

2026-03-11 | SRE oncall (Diego Martinez): Replayed reconciler logs and reproducer in staging. Observed dedupe key absent when retries land within same batch boundary and arrival ordering changes due to proxy bursts.

2026-03-12 | Marcus Lee: Created hotfix PR to enforce idempotent reduction at accumulator ingress. Plan to deploy to staging 2026-03-12 16:00 UTC then to prod 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC with traffic ramp. Notifying customer of provisional credit timeline.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: recent change to postback batching window (microbatch size reduction) removed a delay that previously allowed dedupe metadata to load before accumulator ingestion; when a burst of retries arrives, duplicate postback IDs can be accepted into the hourly accumulator before dedupe check completes.

Confirmed by running synthetic flapping test in staging: when edge proxy returns 502 five times within 10s, postback worker retry loop sends identical postbacks with retry_count increments; accumulator inserted both events when processing concurrency > 4.

Billing analysis: token-level audit shows two entries with same original_request_id for ~2.3k requests, amounting to ~118,700 tokens double-counted for hour 14:00 UTC. This matches customer-reported delta on provisional invoice.
Related code refs: postback-reconciler commit 9f1a3b0 (changed batch window), hourly-accumulator indexing logic lacking CAS-based dedupe for near-simultaneous inserts.
Dashboards: billing/hourly-accumulator/inserts spike graph and postback/retry-rate show correlated spikes 2026-03-09T14:00-14:06Z (https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/accum/accum-spikes?org=4872)
Temporary mitigation suggested: mark affected hour as provisional and block auto-finalize for that hour while fix is deployed; manual credit adjustment post reprocessing.
root_cause: Race condition in hourly-accumulator dedupe path: when postback retries arrive in a tight burst the dedupe metadata load and insert can interleave, allowing duplicate inserts for the same original_request_id under high concurrency after a microbatch timing change.
resolution: Hotfix deployed: postback-reconciler PR#482 implements strong idempotency keys (CAS insert) at accumulator ingress and backfills a reprocess job for the 14:00 UTC hour to recompute hourly aggregates. Team processed the backfill and issued a provisional credit to CortexAI for the duplicated tokens. Prod deployment completed 2026-03-12 23:10 UTC. Billing adjusted and credit applied; customer notified and provisional hold removed.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC: Deployed hotfix to prod behind feature flag. Verified staging reproducer no longer duplicates.
2026-03-12 23:05 UTC: Ran backfill to reprocess hourly-accumulator for org 4872 for 2026-03-09 14:00 window. Aggregate reduced by 118,700 tokens.
2026-03-12 23:15 UTC: Finance applied a manual credit line to customer's account and reissued corrected provisional invoice. Customer confirmed receipt and accepted credit.
Follow-up: schedule invariant tests for postback dedupe race and add an alert on hourly-accumulator duplicate-key rate. Owner: Marcus Lee. ETA for full test coverage: 2026-03-26.
